extracted.intended_audience: LaTeX users and authors typesetting mathematics (mathematicians, publishers, package maintainers)
extracted.subtask_description: Metadata and feature-summary for the amsmath LaTeX package: what it provides, companion packages it loads, documentation, distribution and licensing details, and related packages to consider.

rubrics_metrics.name: amsmath as principal AMS-LaTeX package
rubrics_metrics.description: The principal package in the AMS-LaTeX distribution. It adapts for use in LaTeX most of the mathematical features found in AMS-TeX; it is highly recommended as an adjunct to serious mathematical typesetting in LaTeX.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use amsmath as the central package when preparing serious mathematical documents in LaTeX to obtain AMS-TeX functionality and recommended math typesetting features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic loading of companion packages
rubrics_metrics.description: When amsmath is loaded, AMS-LaTeX packages amsbsy (for bold symbols), amsopn (for operator names) and amstext (for text embedded in mathematics) are also loaded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rely on amsmath to provide these common math utilities rather than loading them separately; expect functionality for bold math, operator name handling, and text-in-math features to be available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compatibility and extension via contributed packages
rubrics_metrics.description: Several contributed packages add still further to its appeal; examples are empheq, which provides functions for decorating and highlighting mathematics, and ntheorem, for specifying theorem (and similar) definitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine amsmath with specialized contributed packages (e.g., empheq for decoration, ntheorem for theorem styling) when you need features beyond amsmath's core functionality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion in major TeX distributions
rubrics_metrics.description: amsmath is part of the LaTeX required distribution; it is contained in TeX Live (as amsmath) and MiKTeX (as amsmath). A TDS archive is available: latex-amsmath.tds.zip.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect amsmath to be available in standard TeX installations; use the TDS archive or your distribution's package manager to install if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation and resources availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation listed includes README.md, implementation notes, a user guide, and a home page (http://www.ams.org/tex/amslatex.html). A downloadable zip archive of the package contents is provided (2.6M).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the user guide and README for usage instructions and implementation notes; follow the home page link for authoritative information and downloads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Versioning and maintenance details
rubrics_metrics.description: Version listed: 2.17z 2025-07-09. Maintainer: The LaTeX Project Team. Copyright: 1995, 2000, 2013 American Mathematical Society; 2016–2025 LaTeX3 Project and American Mathematical Society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the version and maintainer information to ensure you are using a current release and to know whom to contact for issues or bug reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Licensing
rubrics_metrics.description: Licensed under The LaTeX Project Public License 1.3c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with LPPL 1.3c terms when redistributing or modifying the package; consult the license text for obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tagged PDF compatibility statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that tagged-PDF (accessibility metadata) support is only partially compatible; verify output if full tagged-PDF compliance is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related package suggestions
rubrics_metrics.description: Suggestions include related packages such as amsbsy, latex-amsmath, amsproc (AMS conference proceedings class), and mathptmx (Times text font with maths support).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider these related packages/classes depending on needs: bold symbol handling (amsbsy), proceedings document class (amsproc), and font/maths pairing (mathptmx).
